title: M/s J.P.S. Steels Pvt. Ltd. v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J. and Prashant Kumar, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed following Dev Prayag on additional security.
headnote: A writ challenging a distribution licensee's demand of additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is dismissed, the Court following M/s Dev Prayag Paper Mill (Pvt.) that such demand is not bad.
facts: M/s J.P.S. Steels Pvt. Ltd. challenged Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.'s demand notice dated 22 May 2014 for additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 7 July 2014 a Division Bench restrained the demand and connected the writ with similar petitions. At final hearing in 2025, counsel stated that the same issue had been decided against the consumer in M/s Dev Prayag Paper Mill (Pvt.) (Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016, 21 March 2017).

holding_units.holding: A writ seeking quashing of a demand notice for additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 stands dismissed, the Court adopting the conclusion in M/s Dev Prayag Paper Mill (Pvt.) v. State of U.P. (Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016, 21 March 2017) that demand of additional security by the distribution licensee is not bad.
